en.content: Two elements A and B which form 0.15 moles of A2B and AB3 type compounds. If both A2B and AB3 weigh equally, then the atomic weight of A is _____________ times of atomic weight of B.
en.explanation:
Let atomic weight of A = x

and atomic weight of B = y

Molar mass of A2B = 2x + y

and molar mass of AB3 = x + 3y

Now, weight of 0.15 moles of A2B = (2x + y) 0.15

and weight of 0.15 moles of AB3 = (x + 3y) 0.15

Given, weight of 0.15 moles of A2B and AB3 are equal.

(2x + y)0.15 = (x + 3y)0.15

x = 2y

Atomic weight of A is 2 times of atomic weight of B.
